headline: Starbucks China Imposes Seat Restrictions for Non-Paying Customers
summary: Starbucks China rolled out a policy restricting seating exclusively to paying customers, aiming to improve in-store conditions as competition with local domestic coffee brands intensifies.
why: China is Starbucks' primary international market, where low-cost domestic competitors have placed substantial pressure on customer footfall and store margins.

impacts.name: Starbucks Corporation
impacts.why: Prioritizing paying patrons could lift store sales conversion but risks alienating foot traffic amidst price competition.
